description: This Java source file defines a class LaunchSettings that demonstrates Android UI automation tests using the UiAutomator framework. It automates interactions such as opening the All Apps view, selecting the 'Apps' tab, scrolling to find the 'Settings' app, launching it, and verifying the correct package is loaded.

classes.name: LaunchSettings
classes.description: A UiAutomator test class that automates navigating to the Settings app on an Android device and verifying its presence.

methods.name: testDemo
methods.description: The main test method that performs UI interactions to launch the Settings app and validate its package name.
